units.title: Compile required context atoms and expected receipts
units.objective: Extend the existing context-packet owner with revision-bound required full-file atoms that cannot be clipped and an expected-receipt artifact that states only selection/emission evidence. Preserve ContextPacket V2 behavior for existing callers and optional ranked items.

included: enforced_planning/context_packet.py typed required-atom and expected-receipt contracts
Existing required_reading defaults, gates, and relationship edges as atom inputs
Digest, working-tree basis, capacity, missing-input, and compatibility tests
Existing context-packet CLI and installer lineage
excluded: Claims of host delivery, retention, reading, understanding, or provider attention
Fleet rollout, deployment, publication, a new daemon, or a new executable

outputs: Required atom records with repository-relative paths, SHA-256 digests, byte counts, and revision basis
Expected receipt with session, context epoch, action, target, adapter identity, packet digest, and honest visibility
Visible blocking diagnostics for missing or over-capacity required atoms

acceptance.criterion: Every applicable required full-file atom is bound to exact bytes and provenance and is never top-k ranked or clipped.
acceptance.negative_control: A missing required file or required-byte total above capacity blocks packet compilation instead of omitting an atom.

acceptance.criterion: The receipt distinguishes expected context from emitted, delivered, and retained context and binds session plus epoch plus packet digest.
evidence_required: Changed authority invalidates the prior packet and receipt digest
acceptance.negative_control: The library cannot serialize delivered or retained visibility from this adapter.

acceptance.criterion: Existing V2 callers and optional-item budgeting remain byte-for-byte compatible unless the V3 receipt inputs are explicitly supplied.
acceptance.negative_control: Optional item omission remains legal and cannot consume capacity reserved for required atoms.
